summary: Build freight control, document accuracy, and multimodal planning skills in 5 days. Enrol to strengthen shipment execution.
lede: Freight forwarding and multimodal transport coordinates cargo movement across multiple modes through planned bookings, documentation, and handoffs. Designed for professionals managing shipment operations, the course develops practical skills in route planning, document validation, carrier comparison, consolidation, and handling delays or other exceptions. Learners also explore liability allocation and risk controls, and practise creating shipment plans, document checklists, carrier evaluations, and corrective action records.
audienceIntro: This advanced freight forwarding and multimodal transport course is built for professionals who already handle shipment movements and now need stronger control over documentation, routing, carrier coordination, and operational risk.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: working knowledge of export or import operations, transport documentation, and basic international trade terminology. You should be comfortable reading shipment files, packing lists, commercial invoices, and transport instructions. No coding is required. This course assumes you already work in freight forwarding, shipping operations, trade compliance, export documentation, or multimodal logistics, and advanced concepts are taught at an operational application level with some conceptual exposure to liability and network design.
